name: portfolio_policy-decision-outcomes
notes: ADR-0279 Stage 4, the feedback loop: an earlier run's decisions (published back through onboarding, one stream per run file) against a later positions snapshot -> per-symbol projected vs realized per-share growth. Only the hold forecast is scored here; the active side is scored in the child that runs it. The decision run name and the observation date are values of THIS document: scoring a different run or date is a different experiment.

decisions.notes: Role 'data': the decisions/<run>.jsonl file the decision run wrote, acquired through the localtables connector (layout file: the stream is the file stem = the run name), one row per lot, so lot_id is part of the key. Set stream to the run being scored.

positions.notes: Role 'data': every positions snapshot acquired so far; the filter below picks the one observation date.

later.notes: The observation date, declared: one snapshot, so the elapsed time is one number. Set it to a day a positions pull exists for. The two other clauses restate the decision document's snapshot filter (equity longs; tests/test_configs.py pins them equal) so the scored universe is the decided one. They are not what keeps the run alive: DecisionOutcomes reads only the rows a decision matches, so an undecided short or option row is simply not scored. A decided position the filter can no longer see (sold, or no longer EQUITY) is listed as unmatched. Rows dropped here are not counted yet.

outcomes.notes: One outcome per decided lot (key_fields), each matched to its position in the later snapshot on account + symbol (match_fields; one symbol in two accounts is two positions): every lot of a holding sees the same per-share growth, and the decisions differ by lot. Per-share growth (market_value / long_quantity) so a buy or a sell between the two dates is not read as a return; surprise = realized - projected. The forecast is a TOTAL return (price + dividends) and market_value is price only, so each year's total growth g = (hold_value / value)^(1/horizon_years) has income_rate removed before compounding for the elapsed years: projected = (g - income_rate)^elapsed. income_rate is the market dividend yield the decision run fed its forecast (tests/test_configs.py pins it equal to run-hold-vs-redeploy.json market.dividend_yield); beta scaling of income is ignored.

params.source: hold-forecast outcomes per symbol: projected vs realized growth

scored.notes: Role 'report': one file per scoring run under ./outcomes.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd. Placement is not identity.
